target.description: W0 law of docs/wsp/research/phys_spice_w0.md, section 7: smoke point of a microgravity jet flame in coflow. Derived case inputs (SI conversions of nozzle_id_mm and u_air_cm_s, fuel indicators, fuel_mass_flow) are written by tools/wsp/ext/law_inputs.py. (MassFlow is the first target with a shared quantity); targets: smoke_point_length, smoke_point_fuel_flow, flame_length, emits_soot
excludes: spice:smoke_point_length (positive, m): lane-local target, not a shared quantity
spice:flame_length (positive, m): lane-local target, not a shared quantity
spice:emits_soot (binary): lane-local target, not a shared quantity

features.name: nozzle_diameter
features.transform: ln: ln(x / x.nozzle_diameter.centre) / x.nozzle_diameter.scale; refused unless x.nozzle_diameter.lo <= x <= x.nozzle_diameter.hi @1

features.name: coflow_speed
features.transform: ln: ln(x / x.coflow_speed.centre) / x.coflow_speed.scale; refused unless x.coflow_speed.lo <= x <= x.coflow_speed.hi @1

features.name: fuel_mass_flow
features.transform: ln: ln(x / x.fuel_mass_flow.centre) / x.fuel_mass_flow.scale; refused unless x.fuel_mass_flow.lo <= x <= x.fuel_mass_flow.hi @1

features.name: x_fuel
features.transform: ln: ln(x / x.x_fuel.centre) / x.x_fuel.scale; refused unless x.x_fuel.lo <= x <= x.x_fuel.hi @1

features.name: is_propane
features.transform: identity: (x - x.is_propane.centre) / x.is_propane.scale; refused unless x.is_propane.lo <= x <= x.is_propane.hi @1

features.name: is_propylene
features.transform: identity: (x - x.is_propylene.centre) / x.is_propylene.scale; refused unless x.is_propylene.lo <= x <= x.is_propylene.hi @1

features.name: is_methane
features.transform: identity: (x - x.is_methane.centre) / x.is_methane.scale; refused unless x.is_methane.lo <= x <= x.is_methane.hi @1

notes: Generic law forward law.rs, declaration configs/models/law/spice/decl.json (status Declared): {"slug":"spice","status":"declared","family":"other","investigation":"PSI-107, SPICE: laminar gas-jet diffusion flames in coflowing air in the Microgravity Science Glovebox","description":"W0 law of docs/wsp/research/phys_spice_w0.md, section 7: smoke point of a microgravity jet flame in coflow. Derived case inputs (SI conversions of nozzle_id_mm and u_air_cm_s, fuel indicators, fuel_mass_flow) are written by tools/wsp/ext/law_inputs.py.","features":[{"name":"nozzle_diameter","unit":"m","transform":"ln","description":"inner diameter of the fuel nozzle"},{"name":"coflow_speed","unit":"m/s","transform":"ln","description":"duct air speed (anemometer)"},{"name":"fuel_mass_flow","unit":"kg/s","transform":"ln","description":"mass flow of all gas through the nozzle; the two smoke-point targets give it weight zero"},{"name":"x_fuel","unit":"1","transform":"ln","description":"fuel mole fraction of the nozzle gas (balance nitrogen)"},{"name":"is_propane","unit":"1","transform":"identity","description":"indicator"},{"name":"is_propylene","unit":"1","transform":"identity","description":"indicator"},{"name":"is_methane","unit":"1","transform":"identity","description":"indicator (ethylene is the reference fuel)"}],"targets":[{"name":"smoke_point_length","kind":"positive","unit":"m","shared_quantity":null,"causes":[],"scheduled_stop":null,"description":"luminous length, nozzle to tip on the axis, at incipient soot emission (lane-local)"},{"name":"smoke_point_fuel_flow","kind":"positive","unit":"kg/s","shared_quantity":"mass_flow","causes":[],"scheduled_stop":null,"description":"nozzle gas mass flow at the smoke point"},{"name":"flame_length","kind":"positive","unit":"m","shared_quantity":null,"causes":[],"scheduled_stop":null,"description":"luminous length of the flame at a setting (lane-local)"},{"name":"emits_soot","kind":"binary","unit":null,"shared_quantity":null,"causes":[],"scheduled_stop":null,"description":"at this setting soot leaves the tip (at or past the smoke point)"}]}. Each network is N(z) = b0 + skip . z + sum_j w2[j] relu(b1[j] + W1[j, :] . z). A positive target is a mixture of two log-normals of one median exp(N_median), ln-sds N_spread and tail_width * N_spread, weights 1 - tail_weight and tail_weight; a non-positive spread is refused. A binary target is logistic(N_logit). An event target is the competition of log-logistic clocks exp(N_c), shape c.shape, conditioned on no event before the cutoff; the earliest control stage scheduled_stop or flow_stop, and the declared stop condition plus each offset node with a positive weight, take the active mass. Lane-local targets are labelled <slug>:<target> in diagnostics.law and carry no shared quantity. Uncertainty kind: assumed_noise.
